types.name: TextMorphProps
types.doc: Morphs one short label into the next in place. Letters both strings share glide to their new positions, new letters sharpen in, removed letters blur away, and the width follows on a spring so the surrounding layout glides instead of jumping. Use it for status words that change a few letters at a time, such as Publish, Publishing, and Published, or Follow and Following. It stays on one line, and assistive technology reads the plain text.
